prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset: one AI-generated car-identification illustration for an Arabic family quiz.
Subject: 1977 Tyrrell P34 six-wheel Formula One racing car, four small front wheels and two large rear wheels, blue, no sponsor lettering.
Generate a new high-quality realistic studio rendering of precisely this vehicle model and generation. Match its real proportions, characteristic body shape, grille, headlights, windows and wheel layout accurately; do not invent a hybrid car.
Composition: full vehicle from front three-quarter angle (rear three-quarter angle for Tatra 87), centered, wheels and roof wholly visible, landscape 4:3. Soft ivory seamless studio floor and background, subtle contact shadow, natural materials and paint.
Do not reproduce the described original photograph or its environment. No people, scenery, border, watermark or captions. The license plate must be blank. Omit readable model-name lettering that would reveal the answer. Brand emblems may retain their simple graphic shapes. This is a faithful visual illustration, not a document photograph.

review.note: P34 six-wheel Formula car clearly shows four small front wheels and two large rear wheels, unlike ordinary four-wheel single seaters.
review.scope: Broad model-family identification, complete framing and absence of readable model-name answers. Exact year, trim and fine engineering fidelity are not certified.
